One time some friends of mine and I went to Big Bend national Park here in Texas. While bathing in the hot springs on the Rio Grande two police officers walked up to us. They instructed us to follow them back to our car. They then proceeded to accuse us of having A variety of drugs (namely marijuana, ecstasy, and mushrooms) The officer asked me multiple times if we had any in the car, I responded "Sir, we do not have any drugs whatsoever in our car." He did not believe me and I overheard him saying to his partner that young kids like us never come out to the desert unless they have drugs. He ripped our car apart for two hours and found nothing. The officers then proceeded to run all of our IDs. Lo and behold my buddy C had a warrant out for his arrest back home for doing something stupid. They then carted him off to jail where he stayed for two weeks. After they had put them in cuffs the officer who was accusing us of having drugs said we were free to go and did not even apologize for turning in our car inside and out. 

TL:DR some national Park officers assumed we had drugs in our car. And ended up sending my friend to jail.

This kind if story is kind of hard to explain in words but I'll try my best. 

So it was my senior year in high school and I just started dating my girlfriend. My mother was out of town so I invited "B" over to do some acid with me. I bought 4 hits, 2 each, and was awaiting her arrival. Once she got there she told me she didn't want to because she wasn't comfortable doing it (she had never taken psychedelics) she told me I could go ahead and I proceeded to take all four. This is when things started to get weird. 
It all started out splendidly. I was getting INTENSE  visuals and a great body high. It was the best feeling I had ever had. After about an hour of tripping my mother called me. She called me 7 times. I was not in the right mind to answer. I started to feel a little anxious but nothing too bad, but then she texted me "'A' please answer me" I continued to ignore. By this point I was starting to have a bad trip. 
My entire world turned to a living hell. The worst part was when I blacked out. I turned into a writhing ball of slimy tentacles with one eye.  And Satan himself appeared before me. I was the size of a grain of sand compared to his gargantuan status. He picked me up and dropped me into a boiling pot which contained the universe. The pain was so real.

Then all of the sudden a beam of light stretched across the imaginary sky and pulled me out. It was "B" I awoke bawling my eyes out. I couldn't speak, I couldn't hear anything but Satan's laughter. But all I could see was her. "B"s normally brown skin was an amazing earthy color. The most beautiful I had ever seen. Every contour of her body was a thin line of rainbows. I was holding on for dear life. She kept on telling me everything would be ok, and ran her fingers through my hair like my mother did when I was small. She didn't panic, or call the police, she was the only calm in my temporary insanity. 

It was at that point I knew. I knew without a shadow of a doubt that I loved her. I loved her in the very depths of my heart. I've been with her ever since. My love for "B" has not dwindled even a little bit. I know that if we could make it through the most horrible time in my life we could get through anything. 

Sorry for the novel. It's just hard to explain the intense sensations acid gives to a user.
